ننطرح (form VII)
# نَنْطَرِحُ (nanṭariḥu) /nan.tˤa.ri.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْطَرَحَ (inṭaraḥa)
# نَنْطَرِحَ (nanṭariḥa) /nan.tˤa.ri.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَرَحَ (inṭaraḥa)
# نَنْطَرِحْ (nanṭariḥ) /nan.tˤa.riħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْطَرَحَ (inṭaraḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
